name: Kin (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kin town emblem in yellow: a winged ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kin, a town in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 7 November 1977.

features.role: Kin town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised character
